notes:
v0.6.22: tag the bootstrap script under v0.6.22.

The reticulumpi-bootstrap.sh was added in commit d7a2728
(rename) which is AFTER the v0.6.21 tag (18b203b). Trying
to pull the script via
`raw.githubusercontent.com/smeshT/reticulumpi/v0.6.21/scripts/reticulumpi-bootstrap.sh`
returns 404 because the file doesn't exist at that tag.

The v0.6.21 tag is on the bootstrap commit but the file was
named g90-bootstrap.sh there; the rename to reticulumpi-bootstrap.sh
happened in a follow-up commit. So the v0.6.21 tag references
a file at `scripts/g90-bootstrap.sh` (now deleted by the rename).

Cut a new tag v0.6.22 that points to the rename commit so
operators pulling the script by tag get the right filename.
